  dataset_fun: !r |
    function() {
      devtools::load_all("/home/zsigmas/Boehringer/GH/Repos/dv.manager")
      devtools::load_all("/home/zsigmas/Boehringer/GH/Repos/dv.papo")
      res <- dv.papo:::prep_safety_data(5)
      res$adae$AESEV <- factor(sample(
        c("Y", "N", "C"),
        nrow(res$adae),
        replace = TRUE

      res$adae$AESER <- local({
        x <- res$adae$AESER
        factor(sample(
          c("Y", "N", NA_character_),
          size = length(x),
          replace = TRUE
        ))
      })
      res
    }

```{r condition_catcher, include=FALSE}
# Warnings and messages are presented at the end
.condition_log <- data.frame(
  chunk = character(0),
  type = character(0),
  message = character(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

.log_condition <- function(type, x, options) {  
  lines <- strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- sub("^\\s*##\\s?", "", lines)
  keep <- which(nzchar(trimws(lines)))
  lines <- if (length(keep) == 0) character(0) else lines[min(keep):max(keep)]

  .condition_log[nrow(.condition_log) + 1L, ] <<- list(
    chunk = if (is.null(options$label)) "inline" else options$label,
    type = type,
    message = paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
  )
  "" # suppress default inline printing of the warning/message
}

knitr::knit_hooks$set(
  warning = function(x, options) .log_condition("warning", x, options),
  message = function(x, options) .log_condition("message", x, options)
)
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
latex_header_repeat <- function(x) {
  attrs <- attributes(x)
  txt <- as.character(x)
  stopifnot(length(txt) == 1) # only single latex output, avoid other gt objects
  if (!grepl("\\\\endhead", txt)) {
    # the midrule line has trailing spacing in some gt versions
    txt <- sub("(\\\\midrule[^\n]*\n)", "\\1\\\\endhead\n", txt)
  }
  # as.character() drops knit_meta (gt's latex_dependency list), so knitr
  # emits no \usepackage lines -- fails with "Environment longtable undefined"
  attributes(txt) <- attrs
  class(txt) <- "knit_asis"
  txt
}

# gt escapes any backslash in cols_label(), and LaTeX cells can't have real
# line breaks anyway -- so headers (name over label) are built as nested
# tabulars, marked with control chars here and expanded after as_latex() runs.
HDR_OPEN <- "\x1e" # ASCII record separator: wraps header
HDR_BRK <- "\x1d"  # ASCII group separator: name[HDR_BRK](label)

header_labels <- function(data, columns = names(data)) {
  labels <- dv.papo:::get_labels(data, columns)
  labels[is.na(labels)] <- "No Label"
  align <- ifelse(
    vapply(columns, function(cl) is.numeric(data[[cl]]), logical(1)), "r", "l"
  )
  stats::setNames(
    paste0(HDR_OPEN, align, columns, HDR_BRK, "(", labels, ")", HDR_OPEN),
    columns
  )
}

latex_break_headers <- function(x) {
  attrs <- attributes(x)
  txt <- gsub(
    paste0(HDR_OPEN, "(.)(.*?)", HDR_BRK, "(.*?)", HDR_OPEN),
    "\\\\begin{tabular}[b]{@{}\\1@{}} \\\\textbf{\\2} \\\\\\\\ \\3 \\\\end{tabular}",
    as.character(x),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  # Check those marker do not appear in the body
  stopifnot(!grepl(paste0("[", HDR_OPEN, HDR_BRK, "]"), txt))
  attributes(txt) <- attrs
  txt
}


USE_TABLE_ESTIMATION_WIDTH <- 0L

gt_latex_table <- function(data, columns = names(data)) {
  tbl <- gt::gt(as.data.frame(data)[, columns, drop = FALSE])
  tbl <- gt::cols_label(tbl, .list = as.list(header_labels(data, columns))) 
  tbl <- gt::tab_options(
    tbl,
    latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
    table.font.size = gt::px(9)
  )  
  latex_header_repeat(latex_break_headers(gt::as_latex(tbl)))
}
```

```{r mock_app-patient_summary, results='asis'}
local({
  summary_data <- dv.papo:::pt_get_summary_data(
    dataset_list[["adsl"]],
    params[["subjid_var"]],
    params[["patient_summary_vars"]],
    params[["subj_id"]]
  )[["result"]]

  warning("Check errors in the returned value")

  cat(sprintf(
    "\\beginwidepage{%d}\n\n\\begingroup\n\n\\wptabfont\n\n\\subsection{Patient Summary}\n\n%s\n\n\\endgroup\n\n\\stopwidepage\n\n",
    USE_TABLE_ESTIMATION_WIDTH, gt_latex_table(summary_data)
  ))
})
```


```{r mock_app-listings, results='asis'}

local({
  for (listing_label in names(params[["listings"]])) {
    listing_conf <- params[["listings"]][[listing_label]]

    listing_table <- local({
      dataset <- dataset_list[[listing_conf[["dataset"]]]]

      columns <- listing_conf[["default_vars"]]
      if (is.null(columns)) {
        columns <- names(dataset)
      }

      dataset[
        dataset[[params[["subjid_var"]]]] == params[["subj_id"]],
        columns,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    })

    listing_latex <- gt_latex_table(listing_table)

    cat(sprintf(
      "\\beginwidepage{%d}\n\n\\begingroup\n\n\\wptabfont\n\n\\subsection{%s listing}\n\n",
      USE_TABLE_ESTIMATION_WIDTH,
      listing_label
    ))

    # cat() inside a loop bypasses knitr's auto-print, which is what normally
    # registers a knit_asis object's LaTeX package deps (longtable, etc.); redo
    # that registration by hand or \usepackage{longtable} silently goes missing.
    knitr::knit_meta_add(attr(listing_latex, "knit_meta"))
    cat(as.character(listing_latex))
    cat("\n\n\\endgroup\n\n\\stopwidepage\n\n")
  }
})
```

## Data hash:

```{r dynamic_data_hash, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n\n **name**: `%s` **hash**: %s",
```

These hashes are calculated while generating the documentation.

```{r session_info, results = 'asis'}
  session_lines <- capture.output(devtools::session_info())   
  max_char_width <- max(nchar(session_lines))
  
  session_lines <- paste0(session_lines, collapse = "\n")
    
  fmt <- "\n\n\\newpage\n\n\\beginwidepage{%d}\n\n\\begingroup\n\n\\wptabfont\n\n\\section{Session Info}\n\n\\begin{verbatim}\n\n%s\n\n\\end{verbatim}\n\n\\endgroup\n\n\\stopwidepage\n\n"
  cat(sprintf(fmt, max_char_width, session_lines))
    
```


# Warnings & Messages `r local({n <- nrow(.condition_log); sprintf("\\texorpdfstring{\\textcolor{%s}{(%d)}}{(%d)}", if (n == 0) "black" else "red", n, n)})`

```{r warnings-summary, echo=FALSE, comment=""}
local({
  log <- .condition_log

  if (nrow(log) == 0) {
    cat("No warnings or messages were produced during rendering.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(log))) {
    row <- log[i, ]
    # The message kept its own line breaks; indent the continuation lines so a
    # multi-line condition reads as one block under its heading.
    body <- strsplit(row$message, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    cat(
      sprintf("[%s] %s", toupper(row$type), row$chunk),
      paste0("  ", body),
      "",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  }
})
```
